description: Compute the daily session-level conversion rate from product view to purchase. A session is a 'viewer' if it has at least one 'product_view' event. A session is a 'purchaser' if it has a 'purchase' event that occurs strictly after its first 'product_view' event. The day is the UTC date of the session's first product_view. Output columns: event_date (DATE), viewers (INT64), purchasers (INT64), conversion_rate (FLOAT64, purchasers / viewers, 4 decimals).
edge_cases: Purchase that happens before the first product view does not count as a conversion
Session with several product views counts as one viewer
Session with a purchase but no product view is neither a viewer nor a purchaser
Days with zero viewers must not cause a division-by-zero error
common_failure_modes: FM1: Self-joining view rows to purchase rows multiplies sessions with several views
FM3: COUNT(*) instead of COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) counts events rather than sessions
FM7: Ignoring event order counts purchases that preceded the view
